Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Hosted API path: Our security team typically will accept Hosted if a BAA is in place AND we get access to SOC2 Type II report and can either review redacted audit logs or run a scoped audit. Is Redwood able to provide redacted logs for the last 12 months and an SLA on retention?

2) Dedicated vs Private: We prefer not to do on-prem unless absolutely necessary. Dedicated would be fine as long as network isolation and VPC peering options are available. Private VPC would be ideal if there are data residency controls we can’t meet in hosted.

3) Throughput: For pilot, expected peak is ~10 qps with 2-3s average response (context window ~2k tokens). If we scale to production, it could be 50-100 qps depending on use cases.

Procurement timeline: we’re aiming to finalize vendor selection and have contract signed by end of August.

Can you send SOC2 and the draft BAA to security@elarahealth.com and I’ll route to our legal/procurement. Also include any notes about what you can provide for log access and retention.

For audit purposes we can provide scoped extracts of audit logs (redacted) and a secure viewer for auditors under NDA. Our default retention for request/response logs is 90 days in Hosted; we offer extended retention as an add-on (12 months) and log export for audits.

2) Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private:
- Hosted API: Fastest onboarding. Can sign BAA; can provide SOC2 and scoped logs. Default 90d retention (upgradeable). Good fit for pilots and many production workloads if audit access + BAA satisfies your security team.
- Dedicated (Reserved capacity): Dedicated GPU pool, isolated tenancy. Offers VPC peering and longer retention by contract. Typical lead time: ~2-4 weeks after contract and sizing info.
- Private VPC / On-prem: Full private deployment for sensitive/regulatory needs. Longer procurement and on-prem hardware lead times (6-12 weeks typical).

3) Throughput notes: Based on your pilot numbers (10 qps, 2-3s), Hosted should be fine for pilot. If you ramp to 50-100 qps we’d recommend Dedicated to hit latency SLOs economically — I’ll loop in Rishi for cost/throughput numbers below.

Hi Samir — Rishi here (Head of Dedicated/Private Deployments). Quick technical + commercial summary and next steps.

SOC2 & logs:
- We can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II report (already shared by Marissa). For audits we support secure, scoped log exports for up to 12 months under contract and auditor access via a controlled viewer.
- Retention: Hosted default 90 days; add-on for 12 months retention available at contract. Dedicated includes customizable retention in the contract.

Pricing (very high-level ranges):
- Hosted (pilot ~10 qps): minimal onboarding; expected cost ~USD 0.08-0.12 per inference-minute equivalent (est. pilot monthly ~USD 3k-6k depending on usage pattern).
- Dedicated (50-100 qps production): sizing varies; ballpark reserved pool starting at USD 25k/mo for modest capacity, up to USD 75k/mo for higher throughput with preferred latency SLOs. We’ll provide a sizing worksheet.
- Private VPC / On-prem: one-time deployment + infra; typically >USD 150k initial plus ongoing support.

Lead times:
- Hosted: immediate (days) once contract/BAA signed.
- Dedicated: 2-4 weeks from contract + sizing confirmation.
- Private: 6-12 weeks typical.

Next steps:
1) If Hosted + BAA + scoped logs is acceptable to you, we can move to contracting and schedule a technical validation call next week (30-45m).
2) If you prefer Dedicated, we’ll run a sizing call to lock qps & token profiles and then produce a firm quote.

I’ll drop a HubSpot update and a calendar invite for a technical deep-dive. Marissa — sending Draft_BAA to DocuSign now; Samir — expect the DocuSign link shortly.
